verified_facts.text: L'Ermitage was established in 1975 on a palm-lined residential boulevard.
verified_facts.excerpt: Established in 1975 on a palm-lined residential boulevard, L’Ermitage is a discreet, refined getaway located a stone’s throw from the beating heart of Beverly Hills.

verified_facts.text: The hotel sits in a quiet residential enclave within walking distance of Rodeo Drive.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each suite places you within walking distance of Rodeo Drive and the boutiques and galleries of central Beverly Hills, while remaining tucked away in a quiet residential enclave.

verified_facts.text: L'Ermitage is an all-suite hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes. L’Ermitage is an all-suite Beverly Hills hotel offering generously proportioned accommodations designed around privacy, comfort, and residential-style living.

verified_facts.text: Every suite has Frette linens, marble baths, dressing rooms and French balconies.
verified_facts.excerpt: every suite at L’Ermitage Beverly Hills features Frette linens, marble baths, as well as stunning dressing rooms, along with beautiful, sun-filled French balconies

verified_facts.text: Suites have walk-through dressing rooms with full-length triptych mirrors and expansive vanities.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inside, guests will find sumptuous walk-through dressing rooms with ample wardrobe space, full-length triptych mirrors with warm adjustable lighting, and expansive vanities that harken back to Old Hollywood glamour.

verified_facts.text: The seventh-floor L'Ermitage Suite has a screening room, private study, spa treatment room and professional kitchen.
verified_facts.excerpt: this seventh-floor residence offers privacy, comfort, and standout features in equal measure, with an intimate screening room, private study, spa treatment room, and professional kitchen.

verified_facts.text: The fifth-floor Palm Suite has a full-service kitchen and multiple balconies overlooking the hotel's palm trees.
verified_facts.excerpt: this fifth-floor residence offers sprawling floor plans with a grand living space, dining table and full-service kitchen, and multiple balconies overlooking the hotel’s palm trees

verified_facts.text: Heritage Suites have kitchenettes, dining areas, guest powder rooms and French balconies.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Heritage Suites start at 1200 square feet and feature kitchenettes, dining areas, guest powder rooms, and French balconies

verified_facts.text: The rooftop has a heated pool with panoramic views across Los Angeles.
verified_facts.excerpt: High above Beverly Hills, the rooftop offers a secluded place to slow down and take in panoramic views across Los Angeles. Relax beside the heated pool

verified_facts.text: Poza is the rooftop restaurant and bar serving seasonal Californian cuisine and handcrafted cocktails.
verified_facts.excerpt: With panoramic sunset views across Beverly Hills, Poza brings together rooftop dining, seasonal Californian cuisine, and handcrafted cocktails in an elevated open-air setting.

verified_facts.text: Costa Covo serves coastal Mediterranean-inspired cuisine with seasonal California ingredients.
verified_facts.excerpt: Costa Covo serves coastal Mediterranean-inspired cuisine made with seasonal California ingredients and fresh local produce.

verified_facts.text: In-suite dining is available 24 hours.
verified_facts.excerpt: or enjoy 24-hour in-suite dining in the privacy of your accommodation

verified_facts.text: Joanna Czech Studio offers personalized facials, selective body treatments and brow services.
verified_facts.excerpt: At Joanna Czech Studio, personalized facials, selective body treatments, and brow services are tailored to individual skincare needs using Joanna Czech’s renowned methods and protocols.

verified_facts.text: Joanna Czech Studio is on the seventh floor of the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Joanna Czech Studio is situated on the seventh floor of the hotel.

verified_facts.text: The Salon by Alon Shalom offers cuts, color and styling within the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: For hair and styling, The Salon by Alon Shalom offers personalized cuts, color, and styling within the privacy of the hotel.

verified_facts.text: The fitness center has Peloton bikes and Hydrow rowers, with personal trainers available.
verified_facts.excerpt:
- Peloton Bikes
- Hydrow Rowers
- Personal Trainers Available

verified_facts.text: Guests can reset in the SAVA Sound Pod by TERSA.
verified_facts.excerpt: Begin with a personalized treatment at Joanna Czech Studio, reset with the SAVA Sound Pod by TERSA, or spend a quiet afternoon beside the rooftop pool.

verified_facts.text: The concierge can arrange guided Runyon Canyon hikes and Malibu surf lessons.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Concierge can also help arrange personalized experiences including guided Runyon Canyon hikes and Malibu surf lessons

verified_facts.text: Select suites are pet-friendly.
verified_facts.excerpt: Select suites at L’Ermitage Beverly Hills offer the space, privacy, and comfort suited to both guests and their companions.

verified_facts.text: The Palm Suite and L'Ermitage Suite are booked by email or phone with the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: To book this suite, please email or call us at +1 310 278 3344.

verified_facts.text: Accessible Suites include roll-in showers with grab bars, expanded entryways and visual alarms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Accessible Suites combine sophisticated style with ADA features including expanded entryways, lowered switches, roll-in showers with grab bars, visual alarms, among other details for enhanced comfort.
